game.name: Jurassic : The Hunted (USA)
game.desc: Jurassic: The Hunted on Xbox 360 is a first-person shooter that puts the player in the shoes of Craig Dylan, a weapons and survival expert hired by a team of scientists. Following an accident, he is thrown back in time and finds himself alone in the distant past, confronted by a bunch of unsociable dinosaurs. It's up to you to survive with the help of a very substantial arsenal.
